verdict.rationale: Floot's editor-and-preview docs describe an in-editor preview that switches between Desktop, iPhone, Pixel, iPad and a resizable Responsive frame. Founders can point at elements in it for the assistant to act on, and share a no-login development preview, all separate from the one-click publish step. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the preview is fully interactive and updates live as changes are made, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
